comment_regular: Verified save-game block writer handles dynamic ExtraData records but has no ExtraDistantData/XLOD case. This is distinct from plugin-record serialization, whose ExtraDataList_Save case writes XLOD (12 bytes). Whether omitting it from save-game blocks is intentional static-data policy is Probable, not directly stated.
